focal_point: A calm member portrait and a short headline share a quiet field. The portrait is the larger shape; the headline is the message.
eye_path: Z across a wide landscape: face, headline, one invitation, small mark.
grid: Asymmetric split, lots of paper, one axis for type.
scale_ratios: Headline leads. There is no discount numeral. Sizes are few and separated.
type_choices: One or two families, large headline, small support. Close to the three-size rule.
photo_art_direction: A real-looking member, still and capable, soft light, plain ground. Not a laptop stock scene.
offer_placement: The offer is the invitation to get help, not a price. It is clear and quiet. National branding is the part that must not be copied.
trust_and_cta: Carrier and plan marks do trust work. Response is present and not shouted. Style reference only.

focal.reason: The face leads; the headline is a close second.

hierarchy.reason: Few sizes, headline clearly above body.

balance.reason: Asymmetry with a heavy calm side.

photo.reason: The person matches a trust sale.

offer.reason: No numeral, by design; the help line is soft.

cta.reason: Response is findable and not a lockup we should trace.

trust.reason: Trust is the brand system, which we do not reuse.

glance_3s.reason: Glance gets a person and an invitation.

emulate: Large paper, one real person, one short invitation, no urgency chrome.
do_not_copy: Carrier marks, plan names, the portrait, the headline, the color system as a brand.
anti_patterns: None of the government-notice kind. Do not treat the brand system as a template to trace.
summary: Style reference only. A calm insurance front with a real person and room to breathe. Useful for Medicare tone, not for artwork.
